== Usage ==
'''Centralized wording, not meant to be used directly on a file page.''' This template exists so the Frontier attribution/non-CC wording lives in exactly one place — {{tl|License-ED screenshot}}, {{tl|License-Official Frontier media}}, and {{tl|Elite Dangerous screenshot}} all transclude it. If this wording ever needs to change, edit it here once rather than on every file page or every downstream template.


The outer notice uses the <code>noexcerpt</code> class so maintenance/editorial
text is excluded from article excerpts and Page Previews.
